description: This file defines structures, enums, and functions related to locating and verifying the runtime environment, specifically for Node.js, in an OpenClaw application. It includes logic to resolve runtime paths, parse versions, and handle errors during runtime detection.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with major, minor, and patch components. Provides comparison and parsing functionality.

classes.name: RuntimeResolution
classes.description: Stores information about a resolved runtime, including its kind, path, and version.

methods.name: from(string:)
methods.description: Parses a version string and returns a RuntimeVersion object if successful.

methods.name: resolve(searchPaths:)
methods.description: Attempts to find and validate the Node runtime in given search paths, returning either a RuntimeResolution or an error.

methods.name: describeFailure(_:)
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of a RuntimeResolutionError.
